answer: Agents resist sybils with rate-limited nullifiers bound to a challenge canyon: each identity may emit only one timed beacon response per window, and the response must hash-commit to a willow of prior nullifier leaves. Duplicate or bursty paths collide in the nullifier set and burn their rate budget before they can attest, while honest agents keep a single willow branch and a steady beacon cadence. Mass-spawned clones exhaust both canyon hops and nullifier slots, so attestation seats stay scarce without stake or slashing.
